title: Free Novikov-Zinbiel algebra
summary: Let $A$ be a commutative-associative algebra with an invertible derivation $D$, and put $R=D^{-1}$. We study the operations \begin{equation*} x\succ y=R(x)y,\qquad x\prec y=xD(y), \end{equation*} which define a Novikov-Zinbiel algebra. Using a simple graded model, we represent multilinear $\prec,\succ$-monomials by rational functions and construct an explicit basis for the resulting space. This yields a description of the multilinear components of the free Novikov-Zinbiel algebra.
